periods.time: Side story after Bell's Lv.2 promotion
periods.label: Naaza requests quests, faces her debt, and helps create dual potions

name.jp: ナァーザ・エリスイス

status.injury: right arm lost and replaced with silver prosthetic Agateram
status.trauma: cannot stand before monsters without trembling at close range

appearance.overview: A sleepy-looking chienthrope woman with dog ears and tail, usually wearing an asymmetrical top that hides her silver right arm.

attire.default: asymmetrical shirt with right long sleeve, long skirt, leather glove
attire.travel: light travel clothes and asymmetric light armor

personality.summary: Quiet, financially desperate, and guilt-ridden; she scams Bell to protect Miach Familia but later apologizes and risks herself at range to help him.
fears: Miach losing his home because of her debt
flaws: diluted potions and exploited Bell as a customer
uses Bell as bait during the egg hunt
personality.inner_conflict: She believes she ruined Miach Familia, yet wants to protect Miach so badly that she compromises her ethics.

decision_pattern.crisis: Chooses practical solutions quickly, then apologizes when confronted with the harm she caused.

quote_samples: 冒险者委托。可以麻烦你跑一趟吗……
什么都不懂的兔子正好是送上门的肥羊。
遇到什么困难时都跟我说。

mannerisms: tail reveals emotions even when her face does not
uses her nose and dog ears to scout
habits.daily_routine: Runs Miach Familia's shop, makes potions, and manages finances.
quirks: calls Bell a rabbit/sheep when discussing how easy he is to exploit

education.pharmacy: Learned medicine from Miach Familia seniors and gained Mixing after leveling.

formative_events: Lost her right arm and developed monster trauma
Miach bought Agateram for her, causing the familia's crippling debt
background.pre_story: Former members left Miach after the debt; Naaza stayed as the only child with him.

relationships.bell-cranel: Former easy customer whom she deceived, then thanks and compensates after he helps save Miach Familia.
relationships.liliruca-arde: Recognizes Lili as sharp enough to expose diluted potions and negotiate properly.
relationships.miach: Beloved patron; she feels guilty for causing his debt and resents his excessive generosity.
relationships.dian-cecht: Creditor and rival familia deity she despises.

knowledge: Knows blue butterfly wings can support medicine
Knows surface Bloodsaurus are weaker than dungeon originals
Knows monster eggs can be used with blue butterfly wings to make dual potions
secrets: Had diluted potions and overcharged Bell before Lili exposed the practice.
periods.summary: Naaza asks Bell to collect blue butterfly wings, is exposed for diluted potion fraud, reveals her lost arm and Miach Familia's debt, guides the group to Seoro Forest for Bloodsaurus eggs, helps make dual potions, and finally gives Bell a dual potion as apology and proper quest reward.

key_events.summary: Naaza asks Bell to collect blue butterfly wings through an unofficial adventurer quest.
Lili proves Naaza's reward potions are diluted and forces the Miach Familia issue into the open.
Naaza guides the group to collect Bloodsaurus eggs and make dual potions to pay Dian Cecht.
